name: snack machine change
source:
"snack machine change" is a 10-minute story about a boy who is waiting at the hospital for his sister's check-up to be finished.

pass time by buying snacks to munch on and chatting with the other people waiting, if you're in the mood for it.

[From [url=https://npckc.itch.io/snack-machine-change]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《零食机变身》是一个时长10分钟的故事，讲述了一个男孩在医院等待妹妹检查完成的故事。

如果你有心情，可以买些零食吃，并与等待的其他人聊天来打发时间。

[来自[url=https://npckc.itch.io/snack-machine-change]itch.io[/url]]
